profile.reading: Per QTS own site, this Suwanee Data Center 2 facility (DC2) is located at 120 Satellite Blvd NW, Suwanee, GA 30024, part of a 53 acre campus with 50+ MW critical capacity (100+ MW planned).
profile.capacity_note: Part of QTS Suwanee, a 53 acre campus with 50+ MW critical campus capacity (100+ MW planned) (per operators own site); campus total, not per-building.

profile.facility_type_note: Part of QTS's Atlanta-area campus, spanning Atlanta proper, Fayette County, and Gwinnett County, Georgia. Georgia (Atlanta) was one of QTS's earliest markets, per Wikipedia's account of the company's 2005-2007 acquisition-driven expansion.

reading.body:
QTS Suwanee is a 53-acre campus in Gwinnett County with 50+ MW of critical capacity in operation and 100+ MW planned, making it one of four published capacity data center sites in Georgia and the fifth-largest by announced power among the state's mapped facilities. The current 50+ MW operating capacity, assuming 40 kW per rack as a common AI training density, corresponds to roughly 1,250 racks. The campus sits within QTS's broader Atlanta-region footprint, which spans multiple counties and represents one of the operator's earliest markets from its 2003 founding.

The site's published specifications do not detail building-level breakdown, tenant mix, cooling technology, grid interconnection capacity, or delivery timeline for the planned 100+ MW expansion. Certifications and colocation eligibility are not published.

At 50+ MW operational, this campus represents a material but not dominant share of Georgia's published data center capacity: the state totals 66.3 MW across four published facilities. Whether the announced 100+ MW planned capacity materializes depends on power delivery and permitting, which are not published.
